reason: The plugin is primarily an in-session orchestration utility for DeepSeek Harness users: it exposes a session-header control to switch the active agent preset after a model turn, while keeping the same conversation active. Evidence in the README shows it targets the `agent-preset` header action and uses the existing preset-selection RPC to recompute session agent composition, which defines its core user-facing purpose rather than code generation, testing, or data processing.

summaries.zh: 该插件为 DeepSeek Harness 对话会话添加可切换的模式入口，可在模型回复后在同一会话中切换当前代理预设并继续聊天。
summaries.en: This plugin adds an in-chat mode switcher in DeepSeek Harness so you can change the active agent preset after a response and keep chatting in the same session.

capabilities: Mid-conversation switching of the active agent preset/mode
Header UI control to change session preset
Invocation of host agent preset selection API
Session continuation without opening a new conversation

reasons.code: README describes replacing the session header label with a live agent-pre-set switcher and preserving session history while the conversation continues.
README states the plugin calls the standard `agentPreset.select` RPC and relies on host patching of session-switch guard behavior for started sessions.
Manifest in package.json defines a DeepSeek Harness web client plugin bundle with dependency injections, indicating runtime integration into harness UI and agent-selection flow.
